recentItems.title: EVERY Champions League Goal From Matchday 1 | Highlights
recentItems.description:
Watch the full goal highlights showcasing every single goal scored during matchday 1 of the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 season!

With goals from Raphinha, Michael Olise and a hat-trick from Ferran Torres, matchday 1 delivered plenty of goal action in the Champions League.

Which goal was your favourite? Let us know in the comments down below!
